description: This figure group contains a single scanning electron micrograph. Acquisition parameters are printed along the bottom of the image: 20kV, X10,000 magnification, with a 1 µm scale bar. The field shows a strongly banded, lamellar microstructure: coarse parallel lamellae of alternating light/dark contrast run diagonally from upper-left to lower-right over the whole image, with individual bands appearing on the order of a micrometre in width. In the lower part of the field the lamellae terminate against a smoother, darker, largely featureless band. No phase labels, elemental maps, diffraction patterns, axes, legends or numeric data labels are present. The caption places this image in Fig. 3, "Heat treatment at 600 °C", whose two members are (a) 2Al-10Mn-0.4C and (b) 12Al-10Mn-1C; only one panel is present in the supplied pixels, and whether it is (a) or (b) cannot be established from the image alone. The citing text links these 600 °C heat-treated alloys to austenite transformation and κ-carbide precipitation, stating that the 12Al-10Mn-1C alloy did not develop α + κ-carbide lamellar structures but instead an austenite matrix with carbon-depleted regions and globular κ-carbides, so the pronounced lamellar morphology visible here cannot be straightforwardly assigned to that composition.

observations.observation: The panel is a scanning electron micrograph with acquisition text printed at the bottom: 20kV, X10,000 magnification, and a 1 µm scale bar.
The micrograph shows coarse parallel lamellae of alternating light/dark contrast running diagonally from upper-left to lower-right across the whole field.
In the lower part of the field the lamellae terminate against a smoother, darker band that is largely free of lamellar contrast.
No phase labels, elemental maps, diffraction patterns, axes, legends or numeric data labels are printed on this panel.
The caption identifies the figure as 'Heat treatment at 600 °C' and names two members: (a) 2Al-10Mn-0.4C and (b) 12Al-10Mn-1C.
The citing text states that at 12% Al the reactions involved the whole volume (Fig. 3(a)).
The citing text states that a similar austenite transformation was triggered at 12Al-10Mn-1C during tempering at 600 °C (Fig. 3(b)).
The citing text states that the 12Al-10Mn-1C alloy did not develop α + κ-carbide lamellar structures, but an austenite matrix featured by carbon-depleted regions with globular κ-carbides.
The citing text states that the austenite transformation was accompanied by strong κ-carbide precipitation along δ/γ boundaries and poor precipitation of κ-carbides within ferrite.

The citing text asserts that α + κ-carbide lamellar structures were not detected in Fig. 3 and that only globular κ-carbides are embedded in the matrix, which is not verifiable from the lamellar morphology visible in the supplied panel.
